validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: fully confirmed via primary documents, not GEM-derived. Focus Energy Limited filed an Expression of Interest (EOI) with PNGRB on Feb 19, 2018 'for Laying...Natural Gas Pipeline from Langtala Jaisalmer to Bhilwara in Rajasthan' under PNGRB Authorizing Regulations 2008 reg 4(1)/5(6) (https://www.pngrb.gov.in/pdf/eoi/ng/eoi2018/EOI-NG_Focus.pdf -- Focus Energy's own letterhead filing, image-only PDF, OCR-confirmed: 'Sub: Submission of Expression of Interest (EOI) for Laying...Natural Gas Pipeline from Langtala Jaisalmer to Bhilwara in Rajasthan'). PNGRB then solicited stakeholder comments (Public Notice Infra/NGPL/133/FEL/LBPL/01/18 dated 14.03.2018); GAIL and IndianOil both filed formal comment letters, preserved at http://www.pngrb.gov.in/pdf/public-notice/comments04052018.pdf (image-only PDF, OCR-confirmed text includes GAIL's 13.04.2018 letter 'Subject: Focus Energy's EOI for a natural gas pipeline from Langtala, Rajasthan to Bhilwara, Rajasthan under Regulation 4(1)' and IndianOil's 12.04.2018 comment referencing the same notice number). PNGRB then ran a common-carrier construction bid (Tender Ref BID/NGPL/11/2018/01/LBPL/01, dated 10.08.2018) -- its own live tender-tracking page https://pngrb.gov.in/eng-web/ng-bid-11.html lists Tender Type as '(Cancelled)' with a linked cancellation notice dated 06.11.2019. That cancellation notice itself (https://pngrb.gov.in/pdf/ngp/bid/bid11/PublicNotice-CancelllationBid-06.11.2019.pdf, a normal text-layer PDF, pdftotext-confirmed verbatim) reads: 'With respect to the bid invited...for the development of Langtala - Bhilwara Natural Gas Pipeline (Bid No.: BID/NGPL/13/2018/01/LBPL), PNGRB has decided to cancel the entire bid process as the tariff quoted by GAIL (India) Limited (as a sole bidder) was found to be excessively high, impacting the viability of the gas itself.' Economic Times independently reported the same event on Nov 20, 2019 ('GAIL, regulator at odds over Rs 1.5K crore pipeline'): 'PNGRB said on November 6 that it had cancelled the bid process for Langtala-Jodhpur-Bhilwara pipeline...as the tariff quoted by GAIL (India) Ltd was found to be excessively high...That very day, the board also invited bids for laying a new gas pipeline on altered route from Langtala to Pali via Jodhpur.' This is genuinely independent of PNGRB (separate news organization, separate byline) and agrees on every material fact: same bid, same sole bidder, same cancellation ground, same date. CLASSIFICATION: transmission is correct -- GAIL's comment letter frames the line as new supply for GAIL's existing HVJ trunk pipeline system (injection at Kanda SV station), a national-grid connection, not a gathering/feeder line. DUPLICATE CHECK (roster): P0936 is NOT the same physical pipe as P2215 (Langtala-Jodhpur-Pali, 440km) or P2748 (Langtala-Pachpadra, 290km). The PNGRB cancellation notice explicitly names the SAME-DAY successor: 'the board also invited bids for laying a new gas pipeline on altered route from Langtala to Pali via Jodhpur' -- and PNGRB's own tender page for that successor, https://pngrb.gov.in/eng-web/ng-bid-15.html, carries Tender Reference BID/NGPL/15/2019/02/LJPPL dated 06-11-2019 (the exact date of P0936's cancellation), title 'NGPL Bid for Langtala - Jodhpur - Pali Natural Gas Pipeline'. So P0936 (direct/near-direct Langtala-Bhilwara route, 580km, cancelled 2019) is the genealogical PREDECESSOR of P2215 (the Pali-via-Jodhpur re-bid), not a duplicate of it; they are sequential proposals for the same underlying gas (Focus Energy's SGL field), not the same authorization. P2748 (Langtala-Pachpadra) was not found referenced in either bid notice and appears to be a separate, later proposal -- no evidence it is the same entity as P0936. ATTRIBUTION: Owner1=Focus Energy 100% is correct as the originating EOI holder/promoter under reg 4(1); note GAIL was only ever the sole BIDDER to build/operate it under the (cancelled) common-carrier construction bid and never became owner -- worth a ResearcherNotes line distinguishing 'proponent' (Focus Energy) from 'rejected sole bidder' (GAIL) so a future researcher doesn't relabel Owner1 to GAIL. SPEC: Length 580 km and Capacity 1.83 bcm/y both check out -- GAIL's letter states verbatim '580 kms long, 5 MMSCMD capacity Natural Gas Pipeline from Langtala, Jaisalmer (Rajasthan) to Bhilwara (Rajasthan)'; 5 MMSCMD x 365.25 days = ~1.83 bcm/y, an exact match to the sheet's 1.83 bcm/y (not just a plausible ballpark). FuelSource='SGL Field' matches Focus Energy's own EOI text ('The natural gas pipeline will be originated from SGL field...Injection Point: SGL Field, Langtala, Jaisalmer'), also independently referenced in GAIL's letter as 'SGL gas field'. CAVEAT on independence: length/capacity/fuel-source ultimately trace to Focus Energy's own EOI filing (a single origin), corroborated by GAIL's and IndianOil's official regulatory correspondence quoting the same figures without dispute -- this is procedurally strong (two separate large companies reviewed and did not contest the numbers in formal filings to a regulator) but not independently re-measured, so tier is graded medium on the numeric specs even though existence/cancellation is graded high (adversarial, cross-checked by press). ShelvedCancelledType is already 'confirmed' on the sheet -- correct, and now has a real ref to back it (previously blank/current_ref='' per worklist).

fills.researcher_notes: PNGRB's own public notice (No. BID/NGPL/11/2018/01/LBPL/02, Nov 6 2019, plain text-layer PDF, url_verifier gave a bare 200 with no substring check attempted -- confirmed manually with pdftotext -layout, exact text: 'PNGRB has decided to cancel the entire bid process' for the 'Langtala - Bhilwara Natural Gas Pipeline') is the primary cancellation source; the Economic Times article (url_verifier OK on 'GAIL'/'pipeline') is an independent press account of the same Nov 6, 2019 action, naming the same sole bidder (GAIL), same ground (excessive tariff), and the same-day successor re-bid.

Cancellation notice is dated Nov 06, 2019 (matches CancelledYear=2019 exactly). PNGRB's own tender-tracking page independently timestamps the cancellation notice 'Updated Date: 06.11.2019' and shows Tender Type '(Cancelled)'. url_verifier passed the HTML page on tokens Langtala/Bhilwara/Cancelled; the PDF is image-free but its compressed text stream isn't reached by the verifier's naive extractor (a known false-negative pattern per url_verifier.py's own docstring for PDFs) -- confirmed independently with pdftotext -layout.

Every filing is explicitly titled a Natural Gas Pipeline EOI/bid under PNGRB's NGPL Authorizing Regulations 2008. Both PDFs are image-only (scanned) so url_verifier's substring screen can't reach the text layer (200 only) -- OCR (tesseract) confirms 'Natural Gas Pipeline' verbatim on both.

GAIL's comment letter (OCR) describes the line as a new source feeding GAIL's existing HVJ national trunk pipeline system at Kanda SV station, for delivery across UP/MP/Rajasthan/Haryana/Punjab/Gujarat -- a common-carrier transmission line under PNGRB's NGPL Authorizing Regulations, not a gathering/feeder line.

GAIL's letter states the EOI's proposed pipeline is '5 MMSCMD capacity'; 5 MMSCMD x 365 days = 1.825 bcm/y, matching the sheet's 1.83 bcm/y almost to the decimal. Focus Energy's own EOI independently states '5 MMSCMD of natural gas' for transport. Both figures trace back to the one underlying EOI (Focus Energy's own claim); GAIL and IndianOil's official comment letters echo it without disputing it, which is procedural corroboration but not an independent remeasurement -- graded medium/not-independent on that basis, though there is no reason to doubt the number.

GAIL's letter states verbatim '580 kms long...Natural Gas Pipeline from Langtala, Jaisalmer (Rajasthan) to Bhilwara (Rajasthan)', an exact match to the sheet's 580.00 km. Same single-origin caveat as Capacity above: this is Focus Energy's own EOI figure, echoed rather than independently measured by GAIL/IndianOil.

Focus Energy's own EOI (OCR): 'The natural gas pipeline will be originated from SGL field...Injection Point: SGL Field, Langtala, Jaisalmer.' GAIL's letter independently repeats 'SGL gas field' in its own analysis text (not just quoting the EOI verbatim), which is slightly more than pure echo, but still traces to the one gas discovery Focus Energy operates -- graded medium/not fully independent.

Existing StartLocation/EndLocation/State/Country values confirmed correct. Also DEEP-FILLED the two blank district fields: PNGRB's own tender page names the full route as 'Langtala (District-Jaisalmer, Rajasthan)-Jodhpur (District-Jodhpur, Rajasthan)-Bhilwara (District-Bhilwara, Rajasthan)', giving StartPrefecture/District=Jaisalmer and EndPrefecture/District=Bhilwara directly from the regulator's own record (independent of Focus Energy's filing).

Focus Energy Limited (CIN U74999DL1986PLC023587) is the sole EOI proponent per its own Feb 19, 2018 filing, and PNGRB's tender page names the bid 'LBPL' (Langtala-Bhilwara Pipeline) as the authorization sought on Focus Energy's behalf. IMPORTANT: GAIL was only the sole BIDDER competing to build/operate it under the (cancelled) construction bid -- GAIL never held or acquired ownership, so Owner1 should stay Focus Energy, not be relabeled to GAIL by a future pass that only sees 'GAIL' in the cancellation coverage.
ProposalYear/ProposalMonth were both blank. Focus Energy's EOI letter is dated 'February 19th, 2018' -- the original proposal dateline. Image-only PDF; OCR-confirmed date on the letterhead.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: This is a rare case among the 13-row cluster: the cancellation is CONFIRMED, not inferred, and dated to the day. PNGRB's own public notice (BID/NGPL/11/2018/01/LBPL/02, Nov 6, 2019) states it 'decided to cancel the entire bid process' for the Langtala-Bhilwara line because sole bidder GAIL's tariff was excessive; PNGRB's live tender page independently marks the same tender '(Cancelled)'; Economic Times reported the same event, same date, same reason, on Nov 20, 2019, adding that PNGRB simultaneously opened a new bid on an altered route (Langtala-Pali via Jodhpur, i.e. P2215) that same day -- confirmed via PNGRB's own bid-15 tender page, Tender Reference BID/NGPL/15/2019/02/LJPPL dated 06-11-2019. Sheet's CancelledYear=2019 and ShelvedCancelledType=confirmed are both already correct; this pass only adds the missing refs. No newer evidence found that would reopen or revive this specific bid (LBPL/Bid 11) -- the regulator's own action was to replace it with a different-route re-bid, not to relaunch it, so 'confirm' (not 'change') is the right verdict. Searched: PNGRB whatsnew/bid archive pages, Economic Times, general web search for 'Langtala Bhilwara' post-2019 -- nothing found reviving this exact route.

summary: P0936 (Langtala-Bhilwara Gas Pipeline) is a real, well-documented, correctly-classified proposal: Focus Energy filed the EOI in Feb 2018, PNGRB ran a common-carrier bid that GAIL alone entered, and PNGRB formally CANCELLED that bid on Nov 6, 2019 for excessive tariff (PNGRB's own cancellation notice + independent Economic Times coverage, both verified) -- confirming Status=cancelled, ShelvedCancelledType=confirmed, CancelledYear=2019, and matching Length=580km/Capacity=1.83bcm/y/FuelSource=SGL Field exactly; staged 9 ref-fills (Status, Cancelled, Fuel, PipelineType, Capacity, Length, FuelSource, Location incl. two new district fills, Owner) plus a new ProposalYear/Month=2018-02 fill, and confirmed P0936 is the genealogical predecessor of P2215's same-day re-bid, not a duplicate of it. No UNRESOLVED items.
